subject: CALL statement
notes: kb/Work PB238 LANDED. Rule (cite.py OK, 14.9.4.4 rule 8, FORMAT 2): 'An argument that consists merely of a single identifier or literal is regarded as an identifier or literal rather than an arithmetic or boolean expression.' THE REDUCTION IS NOW ONE THING, SHARED. CallBinder.Gr8Classify unwraps an operator-free booleanExpression to its bare valueOperand — BOTH legs, `arithmeticExpression | nonNumericLiteral` — and recovers a sole dataReference from an expression node; the BY CONTENT arm, the BY VALUE arm and both keyword-less arms read it, so GR8 can no longer hold for one spelling and not the others. THE DIVERGENT HALF THIS ROW NAMED IS FIXED: the BY VALUE arm bound every operand as `new BoundComputedOperand(BindByValueExpr(...))`, and CallEmitter.ArgText's computed arm then spelled the crossing with a CONSTANT digit count and the exact-lane carrier. A lone identifier-4 now takes the Place arm and crosses on its OWN carrier with its own Digits/Scale, and 14.9.4.3 SR22's class screen reads the resolved item instead of unwrapping a BoundComputedOperand to recover identifier-ness GR8 says was never lost. MEASURED HARM, BEFORE AND AFTER: `01 F USAGE FLOAT-LONG VALUE 1.5` passed BY VALUE to a `PIC S9(3)V99` formal arrived as 001.00 and now arrives as 001.50 — 14.2.3 GR10 makes the crossing 'a COMPUTE statement without the ROUNDED phrase' into the FORMAL'S description, so the quantization belongs at the receiver at the formal's scale, and the caller's `(Int128)` cast performed it at scale 0. The same defect existed in the genuine-expression arm (`BY VALUE F + 0`), so BOTH arms were fixed: the float lane now crosses as ManagedPointer<double>/<float>, CallAbi.ReadRealCell/WriteRealCell are the callee half, and CallEmitter.CallPlaceIsString no longer claims a float leaf is character-carried. THE ROW'S OWN '19+-digit / long carrier' HALF NO LONGER REPRODUCED on this tree — kb/Work PB264 had already widened that arm to ManagedPointer<Int128> and 38 digits; PIC 9(20) COMP crosses exactly (measured). VERIFIED HALF (BY CONTENT) unchanged. TEST: pb238_call_format2_operands assertions S1 (identifier-4 and arithmetic-expression-1 spellings of the same float value, which MUST agree), S3 (a constant-name is literal-2), S5, S6; pb46_call_format2_as_nested keeps the BY CONTENT half.
